changelog.name: @mezzanine-ui/react@1.5.1
changelog.body:
## `@mezzanine-ui/react@1.5.1`

> Patch release fixing a Storybook-only defect in the `Tabs` size demo, and picking up `core@1.2.1`.

---

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- **`Tabs`** *(story only)* — The `TabsSize` story rendered all four tab groups with nothing selected, despite `activeKey` being wired to state initialised at `'0'`. The shared item lists were fragments, and `flattenChildren` concatenates a fragment's own key onto each child's — so `<TabItem key="0">` inside one ended up keyed `"0.0"` and never matched `activeKey`. Passing the items as an array keeps their keys intact. **The component itself is untouched**; this only corrects the demo.

---

**Compatibility**: requires `@mezzanine-ui/core` ≥ 1.2.1, `@mezzanine-ui/system` ≥ 1.0.2, `@mezzanine-ui/icons` ≥ 1.0.2

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Mezzanine-UI/mezzanine/compare/@mezzanine-ui/react@1.5.0...@mezzanine-ui/react@1.5.1

changelog.name: @mezzanine-ui/react@1.5.0
changelog.body:
## `@mezzanine-ui/react@1.5.0`

> Minor release on two fronts: a broad **accessibility** pass — `Modal` gains a real dialog focus model and `Tooltip` becomes reachable by keyboard and assistive tech, plus a11y fixes across Navigation, Table, Dropdown, and more — and a **`DateRangePicker` correctness + performance** overhaul that stops the hover preview from wiping the range and ends multi-second freezes on large ranges.

---

### 🚀 Improvements

- **`Modal` / `MediaPreviewModal`** — Implements the dialog focus model behind `role="dialog"`. A new `useFocusTrap` hook (now listed in the component index) moves focus into the dialog on open (first focusable element, or the content wrapper itself via `tabIndex={-1}` when nothing is focusable), cycles `Tab` / `Shift+Tab` within the dialog, restores focus to the previously focused element on close, and is aware of nested dialogs. Keyboard users can no longer Tab out of an open dialog into the page behind it. The dialog is also now announced as modal (`aria-modal`).
- **`Tooltip`** — Tooltip content is now reachable by pointer, keyboard, and assistive technology. The render-prop payload gains `onFocus` / `onBlur` (focus opens, blur closes), and the content node emits `role="tooltip"` with a stable `useId` id wired to the trigger's `aria-describedby`. This means an icon-only `Button`'s tooltip text now exists for keyboard and screen-reader users, not just mouse hover.

### 🐛 Bug Fixes — Accessibility

- **`Tooltip`** — The new focus trigger now only opens the tooltip on **keyboard** focus (`:focus-visible`), not on the mousedown focus browsers give a `<button>`. Previously clicking an icon-only button left the tooltip stuck on screen (overlapping, e.g., a Table row action's dropdown) until the button lost focus. Remains WCAG 2.1 SC 1.4.13 conformant.
- **`Button`** — Composes the caller's `ref` with the tooltip's `ref` in icon-only mode, so passing your own ref no longer disables the tooltip wiring.
- **`Navigation`** — Every navigation control now announces itself to assistive tech; the invalid `menuitem` role is dropped from both navigation options and the option category. (Groups/leaves are labelled correctly instead.)
- **`Table`** — Icon-only and dropdown row-action buttons now have accessible names, and the row-action menu is kept inside the viewport (last-column / horizontally-scrolled tables previously clipped it against the right edge with no consumer-facing knob to fix it).
- **`Dropdown`** — Adds floating-ui's `shift` middleware (ordered against `flip` per floating-ui guidance) so a menu anchored near the viewport's right edge is pulled back into view instead of being clipped.
- **`TextField`** — Keeps ARIA input semantics on the native control.
- **`InlineMessage`** — Spreads caller DOM props onto the root element.
- **`ContentHeader`** — The back-button label is now translatable.
- **`PageFooter`** — Stops rendering unnamed empty buttons.

### 🐛 Bug Fixes — Date range selection & performance

- **`DateRangePicker`** — The hover preview no longer resets the range. Selecting a start date, moving the pointer, then clicking the end date previously threw the start away and restarted selection (reproducible by switching months in between — the month arrows just guarantee the pointer crosses a cell, and it's that hover that broke it). `RangeCalendar` now reads the committed value rather than the hover-polluted `calendarValue` when deciding whether a click starts or closes a range.
- **`DateRangePicker`** — The hover-highlight preview and the click guard now ask the **same** question, so the preview never highlights a range the next click then rejects. Hover display anchors are validated before highlighting.
- **`DateRangePicker`** — Ends multi-second freezes on large ranges. The selected range was re-walked one day at a time, six times per render (once per granularity), regardless of whether a disabled-date predicate existed — a 20-year range cost ~524ms per render and a mistyped year (e.g. `4026`, reachable through the inputs) cost ~50s. The scan now lives in `RangeCalendar`, runs only when a predicate exists, steps by the active mode's unit, and is capped at `maxRangeScanSteps` (past the cap it reports "nothing disabled found", leaving an over-long range usable rather than frozen).
- **`Calendar`** — Aligns week scans and rejects incomplete range validation.

---

**Compatibility**: requires `@mezzanine-ui/core` ≥ 1.2.0, `@mezzanine-ui/system` ≥ 1.0.2, `@mezzanine-ui/icons` ≥ 1.0.2

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Mezzanine-UI/mezzanine/compare/@mezzanine-ui/react@1.4.4...@mezzanine-ui/react@1.5.0

changelog.name: @mezzanine-ui/react@1.4.4
changelog.body:
## `@mezzanine-ui/react@1.4.4`

> Patch release fixing two bugs: rapidly-fired `Notifier` messages could silently collapse into one, and `Table` fed fabricated placeholder rows to consumer record callbacks while loading.

---

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- **`Notifier` / `Message`** — Auto-keyed notifiers raised in a tight loop no longer collide and drop. `add()` fell back to `Date.now()` when no key was supplied, which only has millisecond resolution — so several notifiers created within the same millisecond shared a key, and a notifier keyed the same as a live one is treated as an *update* to it. Firing five messages in a loop could therefore display as few as one, silently dropping the rest. Auto-keys now step past the last issued key whenever the clock hasn't advanced, staying numeric and monotonic.
- **`Table`** — Consumer record callbacks are no longer invoked with placeholder rows while `loading`. Previously the table fabricated `{ key: idx }` rows and pushed them through the normal render path, so any `column.render`, `actions.render`, `rowState`, `getCheckboxProps`, `rowExpandable`, `expandedRowRender`, or `isRowDisabled` callback that dereferenced a record field threw a `TypeError` (the value was then discarded in favour of a Skeleton anyway). The body now renders `loadingRowsCount` skeleton rows with **no record at all**, and `record` is optional down the row/cell tree so the "no record callback runs while loading" contract is enforced by the type system. Placeholder rows also no longer borrow real row keys — which previously let them pick up selection / transition styling, be expanded by controlled `expandedRowKeys`, or be wrapped in `Draggable` (the last of which could reorder the real `dataSource` by placeholder index).

---

**Compatibility**: requires `@mezzanine-ui/core` ≥ 1.2.0, `@mezzanine-ui/system` ≥ 1.0.2, `@mezzanine-ui/icons` ≥ 1.0.2

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Mezzanine-UI/mezzanine/compare/@mezzanine-ui/react@1.4.3...@mezzanine-ui/react@1.4.4

changelog.name: @mezzanine-ui/react@1.4.3
changelog.body:
## `@mezzanine-ui/react@1.4.3`

> Patch release fixing a class of CJK IME bug: pressing Enter to confirm an input-method candidate no longer leaks through as a submit / select / confirm across `Form`, `AutoComplete`, `Dropdown`, `Pagination`, and the picker family. Powered by a shared `isImeComposing` helper new in `core@1.2.0`.

---

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- **`Form` / `TagsField`** — Confirming an IME candidate with Enter no longer adds a stray tag. The composition check now also treats Safari's `keyCode 229` as composing (previously only `nativeEvent.isComposing` was checked, which Safari clears too early), via `isImeComposing` *(via `core@1.2.0`)*.
- **`AutoComplete`** — The Enter that confirms an IME candidate no longer selects a highlighted option or triggers the create action. Both are now skipped while composition is active *(via `core@1.2.0`)*.
- **`Dropdown`** — Keyboard selection is skipped while an IME is composing, so confirming a candidate with Enter no longer selects the focused option *(via `core@1.2.0`)*.
- **`Pagination`** — The page-jumper input no longer submits on the Enter that confirms an IME candidate; submission waits until composition ends *(via `core@1.2.0`)*.
- **`DatePicker` / `TimePicker`** — The picker no longer closes or validates on the Enter that confirms an IME candidate. `usePickerValue` skips confirm and blur handling while composing *(via `core@1.2.0`)*.

### 🏗 Internal

- **AutoComplete demo** — Adds a Chinese-option example to the story, useful for exercising the IME behaviour above.

---

**Compatibility**: requires `@mezzanine-ui/core` ≥ 1.2.0, `@mezzanine-ui/system` ≥ 1.0.2, `@mezzanine-ui/icons` ≥ 1.0.2

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Mezzanine-UI/mezzanine/compare/@mezzanine-ui/react@1.4.2...@mezzanine-ui/react@1.4.3
